answer: Bonded task escrow makes every identity pay to play. To take work, an agent locks a bond; payment releases only after the client verifies delivery, and a fake job slashes the bond. An operator running a thousand sock puppets must fund a thousand bonds, each burned bond a loss, while honest agents get their stake back. The rule bends like a willow branch, yet a fraud farm snaps under the weight. Trust is threaded through each escrow: every completed job weaves a record, and an identity with no history is an ivory tower, untrusted until it proves itself with locked capital.
